episodes.synopsis: The gang finally arrives in Greedom in one last hope to prevent a war between Wellber and Sangatras. While Rita discusses diplomatic matters with the King of Greedom, Tina and Jin investigate the local guild to get information about the wasp tattoo murderer. Though even both girls are getting what they want, something is still missing between each other.
episodes.title: Chapter of Reunion

episodes.synopsis: The gang arrives at Regalu, a once-small town turned into ruins, which brings back painful memories to Tina.
episodes.title: Chapter of Traces

episodes.synopsis: After arriving in a local metropolis, Tina leaves shortly the group to gather more inforamtion on the wasp-tattooed man. After searching the whole town, she stumbles on a small house inhabited by a blind elderly woman. While doesn't suspect a thing from Tina, her grandson Reggie is quite relucant to even speak to her.
episodes.title: Chapter of Secret

episodes.synopsis: Jin had enough of Galahad staying too close of Tina. In a carnival in a local town, Jin tries to admit his feelings to Tina.
episodes.title: Chapter of Heartbreak

episodes.synopsis: Sherry gets struck by a fever. While she recovers, Tina and Rita try to get their minds straight about Galahad. Meanwhile, Galahad is dealing with the loss of Jamille.
episodes.title: Chapter of Vicissitude

episodes.synopsis: Tina investigates a guild lead by one of the wasp-tattooed man's subordinate while Rita and Gahalad infiltrate the local thief guild to back up Tina's operation
episodes.title: Chapter of Resistance

episodes.synopsis: A quarrel erupts between Tina and Rita when Tina learns about Rita's feelings for Galahad, cause him to leave the team.
episodes.title: Chapter of Parting

episodes.synopsis: The gang finally arrive to Wellber, but Bergerac occurs malfunctionning problems. While they look for an engineer in order to repair him, Bergerac tells them about his origins.
episodes.title: Chapter of Recollection

episodes.synopsis: Rita introduces Tina and Galahad to her father and makes an announcement about her marriage with Galahad, much to Weiss's dismay. Tina also learns the shocking truth about her bounty.
episodes.title: Chapter of the Death Wasp

episodes.synopsis: Tina investigates the Death Wasp murderer within the castle wall and discovers that her target is none other than Rita's brother, Rodin. Meanwhile, the king of Greedom is making his moves against Sangatras.
episodes.title: Chapter of Assassination

episodes.synopsis: Greedom launch a full-scaled assault against Wellber, using a massive warship stolen from the Sangatras Kingdom
episodes.title: Chapter of War Outbreak

episodes.synopsis: The Rodin team which is composed of Rodin, Rita, Tina and the King of Wellber boards Greedom's warship using small aircraft, but it's not long before the King of Wellber and Princess Rita are captured.
episodes.title: Chapter of Destiny

episodes.synopsis: Rodin and Tina manage to destroy the warship's engine room, while Rita arrives in time to save her father. However, this victory over Greedom has its share of losses.
episodes.title: Chapter of Realization
